mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_object (bucket, object_key, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, etag, kind, uploader_id, status) VALUES (#{bucket}, #{objectKey}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{etag}, #{kind}, #{uploaderId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, bucket, object_key, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, etag, kind, uploader_id, status, deleted_at, created_at FROM file_object WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE file_object SET status = 0, deleted_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE file_object SET status = 1, deleted_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
